title: Joomla contract fact fields (stat values, cities, addresses, quotes, clients, team, prices) require evidence by field role, whatever the module title
steps: S1: Read the newest tracy-business/j6 and ja-voyara/j6 content maps from packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts as the Joomla planner reads them (withFieldEvidence in apps/tracy-web/src/lib/fact-fields.js).
S2: Check the hero stat-value and stat-label cells, the Contact - Branches city and addr cells, Voyara's Home - Stats value and label cells and both singular Testimonial modules (quote, name, role).
S3: Check the site identity module's slots and the hero title.
S4: Run capture-contract.py with --evidence-by-field on a module no title pattern names, and scripts/regate-contract.mjs over a capture made without the flag.
expect: S1: the maps load; every slot the title rule gated is still gated.
S2: every one of those slots has requiresEvidence true.
S3: site identity slots and the hero title stay ungated (the planner may write them).
S4: the flagged capture gates stat-value, stat-label, city and addr and leaves title and lead open; the regated capture equals the flagged one byte for byte.
evidence: 13/10/2026 readiness check on dev: Tracy Business Joomla hero counters came out as "0" or trade words, Branches city cells held the customer's industry, Voyara Home - Stats and Landing - Testimonial were rewritten; the capture gated by module title only (Pricing|Statistics|Testimonials|Clients|Team).
fence: Static: the published profiles in the tree read through the planner's gating, plus the capture tool on a fixture; no site is built.
